screen.agyassistant.guide.title: Quick Start — Antigravity Assistant
screen.agyassistant.guide.subtitle: In-game AI helper for Minecraft. Reopen this guide anytime via the "?" button in chat.
screen.agyassistant.guide.step1.title: 1. Connect a free AI (1 minute)
screen.agyassistant.guide.step1.line1: • OpenRouter with the openrouter/free router is selected by default — it automatically picks an available free model.
screen.agyassistant.guide.step1.line2: • Get a key at openrouter.ai, open Settings, paste your key, and click "Check connection".
screen.agyassistant.guide.step1.line3: • Tip: free models require prompt logging enabled in OpenRouter (Settings → Privacy). Gemini, Groq, and local Ollama are also supported.
screen.agyassistant.guide.step2.title: 2. Ask with in-game context
screen.agyassistant.guide.step2.line2: • %s — capture the looked-at block/entity, held item, or hovered item in inventory / JEI / EMI.
screen.agyassistant.guide.step2.line3: • Camera button next to the input box — attach a clean game screenshot (without the chat overlay).
screen.agyassistant.guide.step3.title: 3. Interactive replies & tips
screen.agyassistant.guide.step3.line1: • Items in replies are clickable: LMB for recipe (JEI/EMI), RMB for uses, MMB for wiki, Shift+LMB to attach to your next question.
screen.agyassistant.guide.step3.line2: • Action buttons under messages let you Copy, Quote, Edit, or Retry.
screen.agyassistant.guide.step3.line3: • You can queue follow-up questions while the AI is still responding.
